senses: to act as law-giver or judge or governor (of God, man)
at theophanic advent for final judgment
to enter into controversy, plead, have controversy together

strongs.def: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
strongs.kjv: [phrase] avenge, [idiom] that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge(-ment), [idiom] needs, plead, reason, rule
